sections.heading: Professional Summary
sections.text: Software engineer with a **B.S. in Computer Engineering** and professional experience in both enterprise software and game development. At **Orion Innovation** I fixed critical bugs in **Java** applications and automated **CI/CD** with **Docker** and **Jenkins**. At **Lobah** I built **multiplayer gameplay systems** in **C++** with the **Gameplay Ability System** for SAMLA, a hero battle royale on Unreal Engine 5. Shipped 5+ team games, two of them nominated at the Futuregames Awards 2025.

bullets: **Owned the Account Level-up Rewards epic** and wrote its **GDD**, coordinating the Online, UI and Art teams through implementation
Acted as the bridge between design specs and engineering on progression features
Worked on [SAMLA](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3988870/SAMLA/), a 36-player hero battle royale on **UE5.6** using **Lyra**, **GAS** and **Game Feature Plugins**
Implemented a **full hero kit end to end** (primary fire, two actives, ultimate, passive) in **C++** with GAS, tuned through data-driven curve tables and developer settings
Built shared **combat-feel systems**: hit flash, an **enemy health bar system** with crosshair reveal, and a weapon hit slow
Created a **destructible loot container system** with GAS health and Chaos multi-stage fracture, and fixed its **replication and client prediction** issues
**Owned the Loot Gathering epic from research to shipping**: competitor analysis, proposal doc, world-anchored loot tooltip and crosshair-focus pickup
Worked on the convoy dynamic objective (damage states, **Wwise** audio hooks) and fixed cross-system bugs in the **damage and targeting pipeline** through **Perforce** code reviews
Identified and fixed **critical bugs in Java applications**, testing and debugging releases with cross-functional teams in **Jira**
Designed and deployed **Docker** containers and automated deployment with **Jenkins CI/CD pipelines**

Built an **AI-based NBA match prediction app** at the company hackathon with **Django**, **Python** and **machine learning**: [github.com/KenanAegean/AIST-Hackathon](https://github.com/KenanAegean/AIST-Hackathon)
Built a **Java Spring Boot** web app that lets employees reserve test environments; worked with the Traffic Test Team on performance bottlenecks in an **Agile** team
